■Direction

...Guess it can't be helped. A loss is a loss.
What do you want from me?

Relying on others, leaving your thinking to them...
In a sorry state like that, of course you can't win.

Is that all ya got? *sigh*... Hey, I can only teach you the technique.
Pulling it off takes serious skill and plenty of luck... It's gonna be brutal practice, got it?

So since you won this time, you've earned the right
to start the next challenge... Is that it?

The carefully aimed 9-ball dropped cleanly into the pocket.
—Victory was mine.

—I did everything... exactly as you told me...!
...Ngh, ah...—
Huh?
—A father devoted to education. And then...

—Beyond that lies the "world" I'm aiming for.
As long as I seize it... everyone will know who's truly the best, won't they?

You're the one who thought it up.
Hurry up and get ready.

...Whatever the people at my place did, they'd have given up eventually.
They had no choice but to put a collar on themselves.

...Soft, just like a certain someone.
If you're trying to tame me with words alone, that's—

Do your best to keep on giving me
those little love bites—won't you, puppy?

Heh. Ahahaha...!
I see, so it was me...

Yet you... managed to tear right through it.
...What was it that returned a pet to the wild?

Heh... Impressive how you can
wag your tail so enthusiastically.

One shot after the break. Taking a wide backswing,
I struck with all my might—straight at the 9-ball in front of me!

Just as she said, only you can take responsibility for your results. Even so...
Anyone can present someone else with "choices."

If there's a cage, break it. If there are chains, tear them apart.
In exchange for having no one to protect you, you gain the freedom to run anywhere—

Boring as hell...
From start to finish, that was entirely your own fault, wasn't it?

—Whoa, whoa... Are you for real?
You seriously think you can win like that...? You an idiot or something?

You're a genuine idiot! But hey, sounds fun. I mean, honestly,
if there's any way to beat that invincible Sirius-senpai...

The moment she spoke of "the world," my heart stirred.
Dreaming of that roar echoing across the entire globe.

The sheer passion she showed when talking with Symboli Rudolf...
Perhaps part of that stemmed from resentment toward her past self.

"Normally hitting out of order is a foul, but... as a handicap,
I'll let you foul up to three times. You can hit them in any order you want. Easy, right?"

............
You didn't talk all that big just to give me a boring match, did you?
...Hmm?

As a Trainer, one can stand by each girl's choices,
literally staking everything... to support them. And that's why—
...Huh?

...
...Well, I guess that's better than a half-hearted bite.

............
It's remarkably simple—

In that case... there's no rule against aiming straight for the 9-ball.
To win, I'll turn that handicap to my advantage—

...First up is roadwork.
Understood.

At the same time, it bred arrogance and complacency. I realized that...
the moment the girl I always ran beside pulled ahead of me.

The instructor at the training club who believed in my talent.
As long as I obediently followed their devoted guidance... I grew stronger. But—
(*CLACK! Rattle—!*)
(*Clack! Clatter—...*)
(*—CLACK!!*)

Why... Why?! 
I've been training so hard, so why...!

*pant, pant*...—Where are you, Rudolf?
...Hey, where are you?! Hey...!!

Amid the taut tension, I took the break shot, and
the balls scattered across the table. ...This is where the real work begins.

So... is this all you want?
This might be your only chance to make your master obey, you know.
"RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!"

Immature... Worst of all, I blamed
my father and instructor's training for my loss.

Dad! Thanks for the new training gear!
I'll master using it in no time!
Because I didn't choose for myself, lost pathetically, and regretted it.

In nine-ball, the rule is to hit the balls in order from 1 to 9,
and whoever pockets the 9-ball first wins.
—Huh...

Coach! That's everything on today's menu, right?
Haha, that was a piece of cake!

—And so began our days of duels to test out better choices...
to decide whose training regimen was truly superior.
